verdict.rationale: Honcho's own `context()` call returns curated reasoning plus conversation history explicitly for agent continuity, and retrieval can be shaped with summaries and token budgets. Session context is listed as a queryable output, so the core of the story is delivered by the product itself. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how session summaries are generated and retrieved across past sessions or threads, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get summaries of past sessions or threads so an agent can pick up where the last conversation left off

citations.quote: context() returns instantly curated reasoning plus conversation history. Everything an agent needs to maintain continuity and efficient enough to use at every turn.
Shape retrieval with search, token budgets, summaries, and peer scoping.
